assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The service is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion.
This service is medically necessary to identify the cause of the syncope and transient neurological deficits reported in the clinical indication.
